definitionEn: Correct in all details and free from factual, quantitative, or methodological error.
meaningVi: chính xác, đúng đắn
existingExample: Calibrating atmospheric sensors regularly is crucial to obtaining accurate measurements of urban particulate pollution.

definitionEn: To accept or admit the existence, validity, or significance of a fact, contribution, or limitation.
meaningVi: thừa nhận, công nhận
existingExample: Policymakers widely acknowledge that technological solutions alone cannot resolve ecological degradation without behavioural change.

definitionEn: Formed or calculated by the combination of many separate units, items, or quantities into a single whole.
meaningVi: tổng hợp, gộp chung
existingExample: Fiscal stimulus packages are primarily designed to boost aggregate demand during periods of prolonged economic stagnation.

definitionEn: To allocate a specific task, responsibility, resource, or numerical value to a particular person or category.
meaningVi: phân công, chỉ định, gán cho
existingExample: In randomised controlled trials, researchers assign participants to treatment or placebo groups solely by chance.

definitionEn: To fasten or join one thing to another, or to attribute particular importance or conditions to something.
meaningVi: gắn liền, đính kèm; đặt (tầm quan trọng)
existingExample: International lending bodies frequently attach stringent governance reforms as conditions to emergency sovereign debt relief.

definitionEn: A writer of a book, scholarly article, report, or official document, or the originator of a plan or idea.
meaningVi: tác giả
existingExample: The lead author of the epidemiological report stressed that correlation between diet and longevity does not prove causation.

definitionEn: A strong force or relationship that unites people or atoms, or a fixed-income certificate issued by a government or corporation.
meaningVi: mối gắn kết; trái phiếu; liên kết (hóa học)
existingExample: Early childhood attachment theory emphasises how a secure emotional bond with caregivers fosters lifelong social resilience.

definitionEn: Of short duration, or expressed concisely in relatively few words without unnecessary detail.
meaningVi: ngắn gọn, súc tích
existingExample: Every scholarly paper should open with a brief abstract summarising its research question, methodology, and principal findings.

definitionEn: Having the ability, fitness, skill, or necessary capacity to perform or achieve a specified task.
meaningVi: có khả năng, có năng lực
existingExample: Modern machine-learning algorithms are capable of detecting subtle retinal anomalies with accuracy comparable to veteran specialists.

definitionEn: To refer formally to a scholarly source, precedent, or piece of evidence as justification for an argument or statement.
meaningVi: trích dẫn, viện dẫn
existingExample: Urban sociologists frequently cite Copenhagen as a benchmark for integrating cycling infrastructure into municipal transport planning.

definitionEn: To work jointly with others towards a shared objective or comply willingly with an investigation or initiative.
meaningVi: hợp tác, phối hợp
existingExample: Transboundary river basins can only be managed sustainably when upstream and downstream nations cooperate on water allocation.

definitionEn: To treat groups unfairly based on bias, or to recognise a subtle difference between two things.
meaningVi: phân biệt đối xử; phân biệt rõ
existingExample: Employment legislation strictly prohibits organisations from using automated screening tools that discriminate against older applicants.

definitionEn: To show a quality, behaviour, or piece of data clearly, or to exhibit objects in a prominent public setting.
meaningVi: thể hiện, biểu lộ; trưng bày
existingExample: Children raised in bilingual households often display heightened executive control when switching between complex cognitive tasks.

definitionEn: Showing a great deal of variety and composed of markedly different elements, backgrounds, or viewpoints.
meaningVi: đa dạng, phong phú
existingExample: Empirical studies consistently demonstrate that cognitively diverse research teams produce more innovative scientific breakthroughs.

definitionEn: A specified sphere of academic knowledge, professional activity, or legal authority.
meaningVi: lĩnh vực, phạm vi chuyên môn; miền
existingExample: Predictive analytics has rapidly expanded beyond finance into the domain of preventative public healthcare.

definitionEn: To prepare written, audio, or genetic material for publication or use by correcting, condensing, or modifying it.
meaningVi: biên tập, chỉnh sửa
existingExample: Advances in CRISPR technology allow molecular biologists to edit specific DNA sequences with unprecedented precision.

definitionEn: To intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or effectiveness of something.
meaningVi: nâng cao, tăng cường, cải thiện
existingExample: Targeted vocational apprenticeships can markedly enhance the employability of young adults entering technical trades.

definitionEn: A large area of land or residential property, or the total assets owned by an individual.
meaningVi: bất động sản; điền trang; di sản
existingExample: Speculative capital inflows into metropolitan real estate have priced many essential public-sector workers out of city centres.

definitionEn: To be greater in number, quantity, or degree than a specified limit, threshold, or expectation.
meaningVi: vượt quá, vượt trội
existingExample: When urban water extraction rates consistently exceed natural aquifer recharge, municipalities face severe seasonal shortages.

definitionEn: A person who possesses comprehensive, authoritative knowledge or specialised skill in a particular academic or technical area.
meaningVi: chuyên gia
existingExample: The parliamentary inquiry summoned an independent cybersecurity expert to evaluate vulnerabilities in national electoral software.

definitionEn: Having or relating to a system of government in which several semi-autonomous states unite under a central authority.
meaningVi: thuộc liên bang
existingExample: Disagreements frequently arise over how fiscal responsibility for higher education should be divided between federal and state budgets.

definitionEn: A fixed payment made to a professional person or public institution in exchange for advice, registration, or services.
meaningVi: phí, lệ phí, học phí
existingExample: Rising university tuition fee levels have prompted fierce debate over whether higher education should remain publicly subsidised.

definitionEn: Able to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances, or capable of bending without breaking.
meaningVi: linh hoạt, mềm dẻo
existingExample: Offering flexible working arrangements has enabled many knowledge-intensive firms to improve staff retention and gender diversity.

definitionEn: The socially constructed roles, identities, and attributes associated with being male, female, or non-binary in a given culture.
meaningVi: giới, giới tính (xét về mặt xã hội)
existingExample: Closing the persistent gender pay gap requires transparent salary auditing alongside affordable national childcare provision.

definitionEn: Lacking knowledge, awareness, or formal information about a particular subject or factual reality.
meaningVi: thiếu hiểu biết, không hay biết
existingExample: Survey findings indicate that many first-time borrowers remain largely ignorant of how compounding interest affects long-term debt.

definitionEn: A statistical measure or composite indicator showing relative change in a price, economic output, or social metric over time.
meaningVi: chỉ số; bảng chỉ mục
existingExample: Economists track the consumer price index every month to evaluate shifts in household purchasing power across major cities.

definitionEn: To hinder, restrain, or prevent an action, biological process, or economic development from proceeding freely.
meaningVi: ức chế, kìm hãm, cản trở
existingExample: Excessive bureaucratic licensing requirements can severely inhibit entrepreneurship among small-scale technology startups.

definitionEn: To cause a process, policy, or formal action to begin.
meaningVi: khởi xướng, bắt đầu
existingExample: Following consecutive droughts, regional agricultural ministries decided to initiate a joint desalination and irrigation scheme.

definitionEn: Data, energy, or resources fed into a system, or helpful advice contributed to a decision.
meaningVi: đầu vào; ý kiến đóng góp
existingExample: Designing effective public health campaigns demands sustained input from frontline nurses as well as academic epidemiologists.

definitionEn: To teach someone a subject or practical skill systematically, or to direct someone formally to carry out a specific action.
meaningVi: hướng dẫn, giảng dạy; chỉ thị
existingExample: Aviation academies use full-motion simulators to instruct trainee pilots on managing rare in-flight mechanical emergencies.

definitionEn: The capacity to acquire and apply knowledge and analytical skills, or the collection of strategic information.
meaningVi: trí thông minh, trí tuệ; thông tin tình báo
existingExample: Rapid deployment of artificial intelligence in radiology has significantly shortened turnaround times for complex diagnostic scans.

definitionEn: An intervening period of time between two events, or a structured gap separating points in a sequence or measurement.
meaningVi: khoảng thời gian, khoảng cách đều
existingExample: Oceanographers deploy automated buoys that record salinity and temperature readings at every thirty-minute interval.

definitionEn: An educational talk delivered to a university class or public audience on a specialised academic topic.
meaningVi: bài giảng (đại học), buổi diễn thuyết
existingExample: While a traditional university lecture conveys foundational theory efficiently, interactive seminars cultivate stronger critical reasoning.

definitionEn: To move from one region, country, or habitat to another, either seasonally or permanently, in search of better conditions.
meaningVi: di cư, di trú; chuyển đổi hệ thống
existingExample: Millions of rural labourers continue to migrate towards coastal industrial hubs in pursuit of higher wages and stable employment.

definitionEn: Of the smallest or lowest amount, degree, or standard possible, required, or legally permitted.
meaningVi: tối thiểu
existingExample: Raising the statutory minimum wage can reduce working poverty, though economists debate its impact on youth hiring.

definitionEn: A central government department headed by a minister and responsible for a specific area of national administration.
meaningVi: bộ (cơ quan chính phủ)
existingExample: The transport ministry announced a ten-year funding package to electrify intercity freight corridors across the country.

definitionEn: A reason, underlying desire, or incentive that drives a person or organisation to pursue a particular course of action.
meaningVi: động cơ, động lực
existingExample: Critics argue that the profit motive alone cannot ensure universal broadband coverage in sparsely populated rural regions.

definitionEn: Not favouring either side in a debate or dispute, or carrying no strong bias.
meaningVi: trung lập, không thiên vị
existingExample: Survey questions must be phrased in strictly neutral language so respondents are not nudged towards predetermined answers.

definitionEn: To come or occur earlier in time, sequence, or logical order than another event or element.
meaningVi: đi trước, xảy ra trước
existingExample: Rigorous environmental impact assessments must precede any formal decision to construct highways through protected wetlands.

definitionEn: To suppose that something is the case on the basis of probability or legal convention, without absolute proof.
meaningVi: cho là, giả định (dựa trên xác suất)
existingExample: Constitutional legal systems presume every defendant innocent until the prosecution establishes guilt beyond reasonable doubt.

definitionEn: Based on or in accordance with clear reason, logical analysis, and empirical evidence rather than emotion.
meaningVi: hợp lý, duy lý, có lý trí
existingExample: Behavioural economics challenges the classical assumption that consumers consistently make purely rational financial decisions.

definitionEn: To return to a normal state of health, strength, or economic stability, or to regain possession of something lost.
meaningVi: phục hồi, khôi phục; thu hồi
existingExample: Degraded coral reef ecosystems can take several decades to recover even after local water pollution is eliminated.

definitionEn: To make previously unknown, concealed, or unapparent information or empirical patterns clearly known.
meaningVi: tiết lộ, cho thấy rõ
existingExample: Ice-core samples drilled from Greenland reveal dramatic fluctuations in atmospheric carbon concentrations over millennia.

definitionEn: The extent of the area, subject matter, or operational reach that a study, policy, or mandate encompasses.
meaningVi: phạm vi, tầm bao quát; dư địa
existingExample: Although the dissertation is ambitious in scope, its empirical analysis focuses primarily on municipal governance in three provinces.

definitionEn: Less important than but closely related or supplementary to a primary entity, function, or organisation.
meaningVi: phụ trợ, thứ yếu; trực thuộc
existingExample: While monetary policy remained the central lever, fiscal incentives played a valuable subsidiary role in stabilising employment.

definitionEn: A narrow strip of magnetic or adhesive material used for recording audio and data or binding objects; figuratively, bureaucratic procedure.
meaningVi: băng từ, băng ghi âm; thủ tục rườm rà (red tape)
existingExample: National archives are digitising fragile magnetic tape recordings from the 1960s to preserve endangered oral histories.

definitionEn: To find, discover, or follow the origin, course, or historical development of something through careful investigation.
meaningVi: truy tìm nguồn gốc, lần theo dấu vết
existingExample: Linguists can trace the evolution of modern Indo-European vocabularies back to ancient agrarian communities across Eurasia.

definitionEn: To make a thorough, dramatic, and lasting change in the form, structure, nature, or function of something.
meaningVi: biến đổi hoàn toàn, chuyển hóa
existingExample: Widespread adoption of mobile banking platforms has helped transform financial inclusion across previously unbanked rural communities.

definitionEn: A system or means of conveying passengers or freight from one location to another.
meaningVi: giao thông vận tải, phương tiện vận chuyển
existingExample: Subsidising reliable public transport is widely viewed as an equitable way to lower urban greenhouse gas emissions.

definitionEn: To be the fundamental cause, basis, or structural principle supporting a visible phenomenon or pattern.
meaningVi: nằm ở nền tảng, là nguyên nhân sâu xa của
existingExample: Structural inequalities in early childhood education often underlie persistent disparities in adult earnings across generations.

definitionEn: To make practical, strategic, and effective use of a resource, technology, or opportunity.
meaningVi: tận dụng, sử dụng hiệu quả
existingExample: Modern smart buildings utilise automated thermal sensors to minimise unnecessary heating and cooling throughout the day.

definitionEn: To modify or adjust to new conditions, environments, or requirements.
meaningVi: thích nghi, điều chỉnh cho phù hợp
existingExample: Coastal ecosystems must rapidly adapt to rising sea levels and shifting ocean temperatures.

definitionEn: A person who has reached full physical, psychological, or legal maturity.
meaningVi: người trưởng thành
existingExample: Longitudinal studies reveal that every adult benefits cognitively from lifelong formal education.

definitionEn: To publicly recommend, support, or argue in favour of a particular policy or cause.
meaningVi: ủng hộ, biện hộ, cổ vũ
existingExample: Many urban planners strongly advocate pedestrian-friendly infrastructure to curb metropolitan air pollution.

definitionEn: Financial, material, or practical assistance provided to a person, institution, or nation in need.
meaningVi: viện trợ, sự hỗ trợ
existingExample: International humanitarian aid plays a pivotal role in stabilising regions devastated by drought.

definitionEn: A medium, pathway, or system through which information, resources, or influence flows.
meaningVi: kênh truyền tải, phương tiện truyền thông
existingExample: Encrypted messaging has emerged as a primary communication channel for remote corporate teams.

definitionEn: Relating to chemistry, or involving the interactions and properties of distinct substances.
meaningVi: thuộc về hóa học, hóa chất
existingExample: Strict environmental legislation governs the disposal of hazardous chemical waste from industrial plants.

definitionEn: Judged over time to be of the highest quality, or serving as a quintessential example of a category.
meaningVi: kinh điển, tiêu biểu, mẫu mực
existingExample: The overfishing of shared marine reserves represents a classic illustration of the tragedy of the commons.

definitionEn: Complete and including all or nearly all relevant elements, aspects, or details.
meaningVi: toàn diện, bao quát
existingExample: The parliamentary committee published a comprehensive review of national renewable energy targets.

definitionEn: To consist of or be made up of specific parts, components, or members.
meaningVi: bao gồm, cấu thành từ
existingExample: Small and medium-sized enterprises comprise over ninety percent of registered businesses in the region.

definitionEn: To establish the truth, validity, or accuracy of something through verifiable evidence.
meaningVi: xác nhận, củng cố bằng chứng
existingExample: Subsequent clinical trials are required to confirm the preliminary efficacy of the experimental vaccine.

definitionEn: Opposite in nature, direction, opinion, or meaning to something previously stated.
meaningVi: trái ngược, đối lập
existingExample: Contrary to widespread public assumption, automation often reshapes rather than destroys overall employment.

definitionEn: To change the form, character, function, or measurement unit of something into another.
meaningVi: chuyển đổi, biến đổi
existingExample: Modern photovoltaic cells can convert solar radiation into usable electricity with unprecedented efficiency.

definitionEn: To link, combine, or connect two factors, elements, or phenomena together.
meaningVi: kết hợp, gắn liền
existingExample: Policymakers should couple carbon pricing with targeted subsidies for low-income households.

definitionEn: A continuous period of ten years, frequently used as a benchmark for historical or statistical trends.
meaningVi: thập kỷ (mười năm)
existingExample: Global investment in clean energy infrastructure has more than tripled over the past decade.

definitionEn: Clearly stated, decided, or established without vagueness or uncertainty.
meaningVi: rõ ràng, xác định, chắc chắn
existingExample: Researchers could not reach a definite conclusion due to the small sample size of the cohort.

definitionEn: To refuse to admit the truth of a statement, or to withhold access to a right or resource.
meaningVi: phủ nhận, từ chối cung cấp
existingExample: Empirical climate records make it impossible to deny the accelerating pace of polar ice melt.

definitionEn: To recognise, ascertain, or establish what makes one entity distinct from another.
meaningVi: phân biệt, tạo sự khác biệt
existingExample: Diagnostic imaging enables clinicians to differentiate benign tissue growths from malignant tumours.

definitionEn: To get rid of waste, unwanted materials, or surplus assets in an orderly manner.
meaningVi: xử lý, thải bỏ
existingExample: Municipal authorities must safely dispose of electronic waste to prevent heavy metals from leaching into groundwater.

definitionEn: Characterised by constant change, energetic activity, or ongoing systemic interaction.
meaningVi: năng động, biến đổi liên tục
existingExample: The contemporary labour market is exceptionally dynamic, demanding continuous reskilling from graduates.

definitionEn: To completely remove, eradicate, or put an end to an undesirable condition or factor.
meaningVi: loại bỏ hoàn toàn, xóa bỏ
existingExample: Coordinated vaccination campaigns have managed to eliminate several once-fatal infectious diseases.

definitionEn: To remove, obtain, or draw out a substance, resource, or piece of information using effort or technology.
meaningVi: chiết xuất, khai thác, trích xuất
existingExample: Advanced mining techniques allow corporations to extract rare earth minerals from deep geological formations.

definitionEn: To formally submit an official document, legal claim, or record to an authority, or to archive it systematically.
meaningVi: nộp hồ sơ, đệ trình, lưu trữ hồ sơ
existingExample: Biotechnology firms routinely file patent applications to safeguard their proprietary research discoveries.

definitionEn: An underlying basis, core principle, or structural groundwork upon which something is built or developed.
meaningVi: nền tảng, cơ sở, quỹ tổ chức
existingExample: Universal primary literacy lays the essential foundation for sustainable national economic development.

definitionEn: The Earth viewed as a single interconnected world or planetary sphere.
meaningVi: địa cầu, toàn thế giới
existingExample: Supply chain disruptions in a single manufacturing hub can swiftly reverberate across the entire globe.

definitionEn: A particular level of rank, quality, academic achievement, or standardised classification.
meaningVi: cấp bậc, hạng chất lượng, điểm số
existingExample: Pharmaceutical manufacturers must rely exclusively on medical grade materials to ensure patient safety.

definitionEn: To provide a formal assurance or make it certain that a specific outcome or standard will be met.
meaningVi: đảm bảo, cam đoan
existingExample: Increased public funding alone cannot guarantee higher educational attainment without effective teacher training.

definitionEn: A structured system in which individuals, groups, or concepts are ranked according to authority, status, or importance.
meaningVi: hệ thống phân cấp, thứ bậc
existingExample: Many contemporary technology firms have flattened their corporate hierarchy to accelerate decision-making.

definitionEn: Exactly the same in every detail, characteristic, or measurable aspect.
meaningVi: giống hệt nhau, đồng nhất
existingExample: To ensure experimental validity, both groups were tested under identical laboratory conditions.

definitionEn: A coherent system of political, economic, or social beliefs and ideals that shapes policy and behaviour.
meaningVi: hệ tư tưởng, ý thức hệ
existingExample: Historians examine how dominant political ideology influenced urban architectural styles throughout the twentieth century.

definitionEn: To deduce or conclude information from empirical evidence and logical reasoning rather than explicit statements.
meaningVi: suy luận, suy ra
existingExample: Archaeologists can infer ancient dietary habits by analysing microscopic residues preserved on pottery shards.

definitionEn: To introduce novel ideas, technologies, products, or methods to improve efficiency or solve problems.
meaningVi: đổi mới, sáng tạo phương pháp mới
existingExample: Fierce global competition compels established industries to continuously innovate or risk market obsolescence.

definitionEn: To place, fit, or introduce an item, clause, or element into another structure or sequence.
meaningVi: chèn vào, đưa vào
existingExample: Geneticists can now insert targeted DNA sequences into crop genomes to enhance drought resilience.

definitionEn: To step into a situation, conflict, or market process in order to alter its course or prevent harm.
meaningVi: can thiệp
existingExample: Central banks occasionally intervene in foreign exchange markets to curb excessive currency volatility.

definitionEn: To separate a single variable, substance, or group from others for analysis, protection, or containment.
meaningVi: cô lập, tách biệt
existingExample: Controlled experiments are specifically designed to isolate the causal effect of a single independent variable.

definitionEn: The collective channels of mass communication, including broadcasting, publishing, and digital platforms.
meaningVi: phương tiện truyền thông đại chúng
existingExample: Digital media has fundamentally transformed how citizens consume news and engage in civic discourse.

definitionEn: A particular way, manner, or system in which something operates, is expressed, or is accomplished.
meaningVi: phương thức, chế độ, hình thức
existingExample: High-speed rail has become an increasingly attractive mode of intercity transport for environmentally conscious commuters.

definitionEn: A prevailing theoretical framework, set of assumptions, or standard model within an academic discipline.
meaningVi: hệ hình, mô hình tư duy chuẩn mực
existingExample: The rise of circular economics represents a profound shift away from the traditional linear consumption paradigm.

definitionEn: The condition of being regarded as more urgent or important than competing considerations.
meaningVi: sự ưu tiên, vấn đề ưu tiên hàng đầu
existingExample: Expanding affordable preventive healthcare should remain a top priority for rapidly ageing societies.

definitionEn: To formally forbid an action, practice, or substance by law, regulation, or official rule.
meaningVi: nghiêm cấm, ngăn cấm bằng luật lệ
existingExample: Several European municipalities have enacted regulations to prohibit high-emission diesel vehicles from city centres.

definitionEn: The act of making written or scholarly work publicly available, or a printed or digital work itself.
meaningVi: ấn phẩm, sự xuất bản công bố
existingExample: Rigorous peer review is an essential prerequisite prior to the publication of empirical findings in reputable journals.

definitionEn: To repeat or reproduce exact words from a text, speech, or authoritative source with attribution.
meaningVi: trích dẫn nguyên văn
existingExample: Scholars must accurately quote primary historical manuscripts to substantiate their interpretive arguments.

definitionEn: To emit a substance into the environment, set free from restraint, or make official information public.
meaningVi: phát thải, giải phóng, công bố
existingExample: Thawing Arctic permafrost could release vast quantities of trapped methane into the global atmosphere.

definitionEn: To turn a trend, process, or legal decision in the opposite direction to restore a prior state.
meaningVi: đảo ngược, lật ngược
existingExample: Large-scale reforestation initiatives are urgently needed to reverse decades of tropical biodiversity loss.

definitionEn: To imitate the conditions, behaviour, or operation of a real-world system using models or software.
meaningVi: mô phỏng
existingExample: Meteorologists employ supercomputers to simulate complex atmospheric patterns and forecast severe storms.

definitionEn: Being the only one of its kind, with no other person, factor, or entity involved.
meaningVi: duy nhất, độc nhất
existingExample: Gross domestic product should not serve as the sole metric for evaluating national well-being.

definitionEn: To present a document, proposal, or manuscript formally for assessment, approval, or consideration.
meaningVi: nộp, đệ trình (để xem xét)
existingExample: Prospective researchers must submit a detailed ethical compliance protocol before recruiting human participants.

definitionEn: A person, institution, or system that follows and takes the place of a predecessor.
meaningVi: người kế nhiệm, thế hệ tiếp nối
existingExample: Each newly elected administration inherits the long-term fiscal obligations established by its predecessor and passed to its successor.

definitionEn: To continue to live, function, or endure despite severe hardship, competition, or environmental stress.
meaningVi: tồn tại, sống sót qua nghịch cảnh
existingExample: Many independent brick-and-mortar bookstores struggle to survive amid the dominance of global e-commerce platforms.

definitionEn: A specific subject matter dealt with in an academic text, debate, lecture, or investigation.
meaningVi: chủ đề, đề tài nghiên cứu
existingExample: Algorithmic transparency has become a contentious topic of debate among legal scholars and software engineers.
